en: Hand-colored historic postcard showing a town square with the town hall (Rathaus) building on the right, bearing signs for "Hotel" and "Rathskeller" and topped with a small clock tower. On the left is a row of two‑story houses and shops, including one with the sign "Gustav Bierkamp." Numerous townspeople, including children, are standing and walking in the open square in front of the buildings. The lower margin contains printed captions identifying the view as the town hall and Lindenauerstraße in Ortrand and credits the local publisher.
